body: Use case: stylized-concept. NEW original Copperhead SC 2006 compact front-engine supercharged two-door NOT fastback coupe game sprite sheet. Reference only worn painterly 2994 salvage style and eight-view layout. Distinct short rounded nose, tall compact passenger cabin, clearly separate short trunk, modest raised rear spoiler, original broad teardrop headlamps and rectangular paired rear lamps, one long door and small triangular rear side window. Burnt copper paint, charcoal bumpers, faded cream repair panels. No logos, badges, text, exact manufacturer trade dress. Eight isolated consistent views 4 columns by2 rows, wide3:1 canvas: top front, frontquarter noseLEFT, fullside noseLEFT, rearquarter noseRIGHT; bottom rear, rearquarter noseLEFT, fullside noseRIGHT, frontquarter noseRIGHT. No tires or rims or wheels: fully transparent wheel arches open to bottom, no opaque black backing, runtime supplies tires. Each view has generous margins, no overlap/cropping. Low game camera, no ground/scenery/shadows. Genuine transparent alpha outside silhouettes. Compact coupe, NOT longhood muscle car or sleek two-seat sports car.
